entries.head: follow up

senses.zh: 过一段时间再联系推进
senses.en: to contact someone again about something not yet finished

example.en: I'll follow up with the client on Monday.
example.zh: 我周一再跟客户联系。

entries.l1_note: “跟进”不是 follow（跟着走）；商务场景必须 follow up。

entries.head: put forward

senses.en: to suggest an idea for other people to consider

example.en: I put forward a plan for working from home two days a week.
example.zh: 我提了个一周两天远程的方案。

entries.l1_note: “提出”不是 put out（那是熄灭、拿出）；提建议用 put forward。

entries.head: reach out

senses.zh: 给别人发消息或打电话
senses.en: to contact someone to ask for help or offer something

example.en: Feel free to reach out if you have any questions.
example.zh: 有问题随时联系我。

entries.l1_note: 商务邮件里“联系我”不是 contact with me（错），是 reach out to me / contact me。

entries.head: touch base

senses.en: to talk to someone briefly to share updates

example.en: Let's touch base on Friday before the client meeting.
example.zh: 周五见客户前我们先碰一下。

entries.l1_note: 商务口头语，不是“接触基地”；中文没有对应词，别逐字翻。

entries.head: run by
entries.zh: 先给某人过目、征求同意

senses.en: to tell someone an idea to get their opinion

example.en: Let me run this by my manager before we commit.
example.zh: 正式定下来之前我先跟经理过一下这个想法。

entries.l1_note: “跟领导说一下”不是 tell my boss 就完事；run it by someone 是征求同意。代词夹中间。
collocations: run an idea by the team

entries.head: wrap up

senses.en: to finish a meeting or piece of work

example.en: Let's wrap up in five minutes — I have another call.
example.zh: 我们五分钟内收尾吧，我还有个电话会。

entries.l1_note: “收尾”不是 close the meeting 才地道；wrap up 更口语。

entries.head: hand over

senses.en: to give control or responsibility to someone else

example.en: I'll hand over the files before I leave on Friday.
example.zh: 我周五走之前把文件交接好。

collocations: hand over to the new manager
entries.l1_note: 移交是 hand over；hand in 是交作业，别混。

entries.head: take over

senses.zh: 接手别人的工作或职位
senses.en: to take control of a job or company from someone

example.en: She's taking over the account while he's on leave.
example.zh: 他休假期间她接手这个客户。

entries.l1_note: 接手工作不是 take the work over 才自然；take over 后直接跟宾语即可。

entries.head: look into

senses.en: to try to find out the facts about something

example.en: Thanks for the report — I'll look into it today.
example.zh: 谢谢反馈，我今天就去查一下。

entries.l1_note: “调查”不是 look for（那是找东西）；look into 才是查原因。

entries.head: go over

senses.en: to examine or review something carefully

example.en: Let's go over the answers before the test.
example.zh: 考试前我们把答案过一遍。

entries.l1_note: “复习”不是 review it again and again 才自然；go over 更口语。

entries.head: run through

senses.en: to practice or review something quickly

example.en: Let's run through the slides once before we present.
example.zh: 上讲台前我们把幻灯片过一遍。

entries.l1_note: 演练是 run through；run over 是碾过，别混。

entries.head: come up with

senses.en: to think of an idea or solution

example.en: Nobody could come up with a better name for the app.
example.zh: 没人能想出一个更好的 App 名字。

entries.l1_note: “想出”不是 think out / think up（也可以但少）；come up with 后直接跟想出的东西。

entries.head: go ahead

senses.en: used to give someone permission to start

example.en: If you're ready, go ahead and send the email.
example.zh: 准备好了就把邮件发出去吧。

entries.l1_note: “你先来”不是 you first 才地道；go ahead 是许可也是让对方先做。

entries.head: make up

senses.en: to become friends again after an argument

example.en: They argued for an hour and made up before dessert.
example.zh: 他们吵了一小时，甜点还没上就和好了。

senses.en: to invent a story or excuse

example.en: He made up some excuse about traffic.
example.zh: 他编了个堵车的借口。

entries.l1_note: 和好用 make up 或 make up with someone；编故事也是 make up，靠上下文区分。

entries.head: keep up with

senses.en: to stay at the same speed or level as something

example.en: I can't keep up with the reading list this semester.
example.zh: 这学期书单我跟不上了。

entries.l1_note: “跟上”不是 follow up（那是后续跟进）；进度用 keep up with。

entries.head: spell out

senses.en: to explain something in very clear detail

example.en: Let me spell out what the client actually needs.
example.zh: 我把客户到底要什么讲清楚。

entries.l1_note: 讲清楚是 spell out，不是 say clearly（太泛）。

entries.head: lay out

senses.en: to explain something in an organized way

example.en: She laid out three options for the launch.
example.zh: 她把上线的三个方案摆出来讲。

entries.l1_note: lay out 是摊开讲；layout 名词是布局。

entries.head: touch on

senses.en: to mention a subject briefly

example.en: He touched on the budget but didn't give numbers.
example.zh: 他提到了预算但没给数字。

entries.l1_note: 简单提到是 touch on，不是 touch（摸）。

entries.head: sum up

senses.en: to give the main points again

example.en: Let me sum up before we vote.
example.zh: 投票前我先总结一下。

entries.l1_note: 总结是 sum up；不是 summarize up（重复）。

entries.head: follow through

senses.en: to complete what you promised

example.en: He never follows through on anything he says.
example.zh: 他说的话从来没有落实过。

entries.l1_note: 落实是 follow through (on)；follow up 是跟进联系。

entries.head: carry out

senses.en: to do a plan or task

example.en: We carried out the survey over two weeks.
example.zh: 我们用两周完成了这项调查。

entries.l1_note: 执行是 carry out；carry on 是继续。

entries.head: loop in

senses.en: to include someone in a conversation

example.en: Loop in legal before you reply to the client.
example.zh: 回复客户前把法务拉进来。

entries.l1_note: 拉进沟通是 loop in；不是 add to the email（太具体）。

entries.head: call back

senses.en: to phone someone again

example.en: I'll call you back after this meeting.
example.zh: 开完这个会我给你回电话。

entries.l1_note: 回电是 call back；不是 return a call（也行但正式）。

entries.head: hear back

senses.en: to receive a reply from someone

example.en: I applied last week and still haven't heard back.
example.zh: 我上周投的，到现在没回音。

entries.l1_note: 收到回复是 hear back (from)，不是 receive back（中式）。

entries.head: check with

senses.en: to ask someone before deciding

example.en: Check with your manager before you promise a date.
example.zh: 答应日期前先问下经理。

entries.l1_note: 问一下是 check with；check 单独是检查。

entries.head: run past

senses.en: to show an idea to someone for approval

example.en: Run it past the design lead before you build it.
example.zh: 做之前先给设计负责人过一下。

entries.l1_note: 过目征求意见是 run it past someone；代词夹中间。

entries.head: sign off

senses.en: to give official approval

example.en: Finance has to sign off on anything over 10,000.
example.zh: 超过一万的都要财务批。

entries.l1_note: 批准是 sign off (on)；签字≠签名（sign）。

entries.head: iron out

senses.en: to solve small problems

example.en: We ironed out the last few issues before launch.
example.zh: 上线前我们摆平了最后几个问题。

entries.l1_note: 摆平细节是 iron out，画面是熨平。

entries.head: hammer out

senses.en: to reach an agreement after a lot of discussion

example.en: They hammered out a deal after midnight.
example.zh: 过了午夜他们才谈成协议。

entries.l1_note: 谈定是 hammer out，带“反复敲”的意味。

entries.head: pass on

senses.en: to give a message to someone else

example.en: Could you pass on the message to the night shift?
example.zh: 能把这个消息带给夜班吗？

entries.l1_note: 转达是 pass on；pass 是递过去。
